# Verify Report: fix-slugify-diacritics
Verdict: PASS WITH WARNINGS

## Completeness
6/6 plan tasks complete (0.1, 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1). Changes uncommitted by orchestrator instruction.

## Build
No build step (plain ESM JS, no tsc). N/A.

## Tests (fresh run)
npm test: 3 files, 24/24 pass (slugify 18, truncate 3, case 3).

## Coverage
No coverage threshold configured; not measured.

## Spec compliance matrix (16 scenarios, all in test/slugify.test.js)
| Req | Scenario | Test | Status |
| REQ-001 | S1 Crème Brûlée | transliterates accented Latin letters (REQ-001 S1) | PASS |
| REQ-001 | S2 Café Münster | ...acute and umlaut (S2) | PASS |
| REQ-001 | S3 ÉCOLE ÀÇÑ | ...uppercase accented (S3) | PASS |
| REQ-001 | S4 edge trim | leaves no edge dashes (S4) | PASS |
| REQ-002 | S1 NFC/NFD Crème | treats precomposed and decomposed alike | PASS |
| REQ-002 | S2 phrase | treats NFC and NFD phrases alike | PASS |
| REQ-002 | S3 lone é | handles a lone accented letter | PASS |
| REQ-003 | S1-S3 ASCII | 3 pre-existing tests, unmodified | PASS |
| REQ-003 | S4 empty/!!! | returns empty string... | PASS |
| REQ-004 | S1 Straße Øl | keeps non-decomposable Latin as-is | PASS |
| REQ-004 | S2 Cyrillic/CJK | leaves mark-free non-Latin unchanged | PASS |
| REQ-005 | S1 export shape | keeps the public API shape | PASS |
| REQ-005 | S2 deps unchanged | no test; verified by git status/diff (package.json not modified) | PASS (non-runtime) |
| REQ-005 | S3 coercion | coerces non-string input | PASS |
Extra guards: Cyrillic й, Hangul, Devanagari pin. 16/16 compliant.

## Success criteria
SC1 met (creme-brulee, cafe-munster tests pass). SC2 met (NFC/NFD tests). SC3 met (3 ASCII tests unmodified, pass). SC4 met (npm test green; package.json unchanged). SC5 met: git status shows only M src/slugify.js and M test/slugify.test.js; git diff --stat: 2 files, 74 insertions; README/package.json untouched.

## Coherence
src/slugify.js matches design D1-D4 exactly: lower -> trim -> NFD -> strip U+0300-036F after \p{Script=Latin} -> NFC -> replace; no signature/export change; no new files.

## Issues
CRITICAL: none.
WARNING: Hangul guard does not fail under mutation (NFC recomposes); regression-only value (accepted).
OBSERVATION: decomposed Cyrillic input (и + U+0306) now yields 'й' after NFC (previously 'и'); arguably a benign canonicalization, not pinned by a test.
SUGGESTION: optional README note skipped; ß/ø/æ/ł transliteration remains a follow-up (Approach B); REQ-005 S2 has no automated test.
